name: Expo GitHub Action
description: Publish, build or manage your Expo app with GitHub Actions

expo-cache.description: If Expo CLI should be cached to speed up installation

eas-cache.description: If EAS CLI should be cached to speed up installation

packager.description: The package manager used to install the CLIs

patch-watchers.description: If the action should patch the ENOSPC errors

token.description: Your Expo token, for authentication. (use with secrets)

eas-cache-key.description: A custom remote cache key to use for EAS CLI.

expo-cache-key.description: A custom remote cache key to use for Expo CLI.

password.description: Your Expo password, for authentication. (use with secrets)
